verify_detail: Why DO NOT SHIP\nThe persistence bug directly undermines the app\'s single purpose — a "ping counter" that can silently forget your pings on this exact class of device (Wear OS, small RAM, constant ambient-mode transitions) is a data-integrity defect, not a polish issue. I\'d ship only after the count is backed by durable storage (or at minimum `rememberSaveable`/`SavedStateHandle` to survive recreation) and after the team confirms whether the orphaned about/diagnostics screens are intentional.'
